uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
attached to the creature that has Mortarpod attached

219-385-5972.description:
Activate the creature that has Mortarpod and Cartouche of Solidarity attached by sacrificing it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning Cartouche of Solidarity from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature, and then attaching Mortarpod to the same creature.
When Cartouche of Solidarity enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2060-2092-5140-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-2092-5140-7803.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-7803.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

511-560-817-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-560-817-4050-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus an additional creature token due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2469-5220-6578-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
2469-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

4559-4802-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-5686-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6005-7057-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

2894-5010-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2894-5010-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Thug. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Thug's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5056-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1978-5056-5704.description:
Cause Leafkin Avenger to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-2829-5220-6900.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

957-2061-6927.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2624-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2624-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1090-6132-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-6132-6797.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2653-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
2653-5720-5721-6620.notes: If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

262-1978-2034.description:
Activate the artifact creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three loyalty counters on it

193-1124-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
193-1124-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking The Chain Veil.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Palinchron and killing Aminatou due to it having zero loyalty, causing it to be returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Cast Aminatou from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B} plus commander tax.
Repeat steps 2 through 7 one additional time.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and then put a card on top of your library.
Repeat step 13 until the number of loyalty counters on Aminatou is equal to the number of activations of Aminatou's abilities you have remaining this turn.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 until Aminatou dies due to it having zero loyalty and is returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 11.
193-1124-3542.notes: The combo is written to assume that Aminatou has a commander tax of 0, and that The Chain Veil has not been activated during the current turn. If either of these is not true, the costs of the combo may change accordingly.

1274-3490-3641-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-3641-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

372-3378-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-4477.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2532-2608-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-2608-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos and Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos token triggers once, and the Derevi token triggers twice.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve both Derevi triggers, untapping Jaxis and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

1323-1432.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
Ioreth of the Healing House has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Experiment Kraj and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
1323-1432.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Experiment Kraj and any other legendary creature you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and any other legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

2429-2713-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-2713-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

549-749-1558-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Lena.
You control at least four nontoken creatures.
549-749-1558-1692.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lena with haste.
The Lena token triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of nontoken creatures you control.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-1949-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Paradox Haze and Tamiyo's Journal trigger.
Resolve the Paradox Haze trigger, getting an additional upkeep step after this one.
Resolve the Tamiyo's Journal trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
At the beginning of your second upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2819-3011.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu and Goblin Goliath do not have summoning sickness.
2819-3011.description:
Activate Goblin Goliath by paying {3}{R} and tapping it, causing you to deal double the damage to opponent this turn.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you equal to half your life total rounded down.

637-2452-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archghoul of Thraben, adding one mana of any color.
Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Archghoul of Thraben on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Archghoul of Thraben from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast Archghoul of Thraben by paying {0}.
Repeat.
